Chapter 6647: Cosmic Immortal Avatar

Chapter 6647: Cosmic Immortal Avatar

“Clank!” A bell could be heard everywhere in Three Immortals.

“The golden bell.” All eyes were on Life and Death Heaven upon hearing the famous bell.

“A call for evacuation.” An old primal ancestor understood.

“It’s been a long time.” Another ancient ancestor murmured.

“The Lord of Life and Death will face the tribulation, everyone must leave now.” Someone else had experience with this before.

“It will initiate a grand momentum, anyone who dares to get close will be attacked.” A heaven-slayer whispered while observing the area.

“Putting the enemies aside, that tribulation will incite others too if they are too close. This happened to several famous cultivators during Bodhi Ancestor’s ascension, they died needlessly to their personal tribulation.” A primal ancestor said.

“We can leave, just have to start a dao platform.” Many left but initiated a dao platform and heavenly mirror to watch.

“No, get the hell out now, don’t be caught in it.” Powerful cultivators only wanted to survive.

“Buzz.” Life and Death Heaven became resplendent after the bell. Pillars of light erupted everywhere, culminating in an insane power.

People couldn’t tell if Three Immortals were being pushed back or the heaven simply moved away. All in all, the two separated.

An ocean of life emerged and swept through the world. It opened up a dimension with the cycles of life and death.

Pillars appeared all around and formed a great battlefield with the heaven in the center. It was vast enough to accommodate all of Heaven World.

Layers of ramparts formed around it, preventing anyone from getting inside. A special sky also appeared and was connected to the deepest location of the faction. Everyone could tell this was the lord’s chosen ground to ascend.

“The battlefield is ready, the ascension field is chosen, they are ready.” Spectators were amazed.

The faction entered a new dimension on top of opening a battlefield larger than Heaven World itself.

“Their resources can’t be overstated.” An emperor said.

“Rumble!” A massive gate opened. When standing before it and looking up, it resembled a towering mountain.

“Screech.” A phoenix screech could be heard before the appearance of Cosmic Surge Legion.

“Skyfire Phoenix and Cosmic Surge.” Others watched in amazement.

Their auras swept through the battlefield, dazzling spectators.

The force of life and death poured out from the gate - the sign of an activated grand momentum.

“Immortal Guard Formation!” Skyfire Phoenix channeled all of her power into this formation.

“Immortal Guard!” The troops roared with weapons and shields at the ready.

Loyal primal ancestors and heaven-slayers also channeled their power. The formation took the form of a fiery phoenix flying around the battlefield.

“Boom!” A figure of light appeared as well, made from celestial and immortal stars. The stars acted as the skeleton while space was its flesh.

“Cosmic Immortal Avatar!” Spectators became emotional.

“So it’s real.” Someone observed the avatar illuminating everything with its light and immortal power.

“Desolate Ancestor really created this grand momentum for the heaven.” Another said.

“No one in this world can break it down.” Primal ancestors and heaven-slayers found themselves inadequate.

Rumor has it Desolate Ancestor used the foundation and resources of Life and Death Heaven for the base. The legion served as the momentum and fuel.
